site_description: Van Nhan Buddha Statue workshop specializes in Buddhist fine-art sculptures: outdoor Buddha statues, indoor worship statues, Buddhist reliefs, temple ornaments, sacred animals and ritual symbols. Crafted in poly resin, AB resin, bronze, stone, wood, ceramic and foam.

about_text_1: First of all, Van Nhan Buddha Statue respectfully greets Buddhists and valued customers near and far, and wishes everyone good health and prosperity in every field.
about_text_2: We specialize in decorative fine-art sculpture projects for temples and pagodas: ornaments, ritual objects, sacred animals and ritual symbols, outdoor statues, restoration of venerable statues, display decoration, temple park landscaping and Buddhist reliefs.
about_text_3: We also fabricate and supply products in many materials such as poly resin, AB resin, bronze, stone, wood, ceramic and foam, meeting every need of size, style and color.
